title: Classification Rite — Identity Protocol
entrance_text: The System's light coalesces around you, shifting from the warm blue of the square into something colder.
It is not reading your history. It has no access to that.
It is reading what you ARE — the fundamental data of your existence.
And before it can assign you a purpose, it needs to understand what you are made of.

root.text:
IDENTITY PROTOCOL INITIATED.

The System begins its assessment. First: the most basic classification. The shape of the self.

options.label: Try to resist the System's scan.

resist_scan.text:
The light pauses. For three full seconds, nothing happens.

Then it intensifies — not violently, but deliberately. The System is not asking. It is waiting for you to tire first.

You do. Eventually.

options.label: Stop fighting it. Let it read what it needs.

gender.text:
The System registers the first layer of your identity.

It does not judge. It catalogues.

options.label: That's none of the System's business.

species.text:
SPECIES CLASSIFICATION PROTOCOL.

The System identifies the biological framework of your existence. Each carries its own history, its own strengths, its own relationship with the world the Fracture remade.

options.label: Aetherian Elf — Ancient bloodline. Deep magic. Long memory.
Beast-Kin — Fast, fierce, instinctive. The wild doesn't leave you.
Stone Dwarf — Enduring, crafted by geology, unbothered by catastrophe.
Void-Touched — Something from the deep Fracture zones. Lucky. Unstable. Undefined.

species_human_confirm.text:
HUMAN.

The System has more data on humans than any other species. It still can't predict them.

Base bonuses: LCK +1
Evolution path: Awakened Human → System-Touched → System Breaker
Class affinity: All classes

The System marks you as: WILDCARD.

species_elf_confirm.text:
AETHERIAN ELF.

The System pauses slightly longer than usual. The Aetherian bloodline predates its own records.

Base bonuses: INT +3, AGI +2, WIS +2, Perception +3
Growth affinity: INT, WIS
Evolution path: Starwarden → Ancient One → Void-Born Elf
Class affinity: Mage, Priest, Ranger

The System marks you as: LEGACY ENTITY.

species_beast_confirm.text:
BEAST-KIN.

The System notes elevated biological response patterns. Fight-or-flight is not a reaction for Beast-Kin — it is a permanent state, refined into an art form.

Base bonuses: STR +2, AGI +3, VIT +2, END +1, Perception +2
Growth affinity: STR, AGI
Evolution path: Primal Awakening → Apex Predator → Primordial
Class affinity: Warrior, Rogue, Ranger

The System marks you as: APEX POTENTIAL.

options.label: The hunt continues. This is who I am.

species_dwarf_confirm.text:
STONE DWARF.

The System registers exceptional structural integrity. Also: an alarming stubbornness reading that it initially flagged as a sensor error.

Base bonuses: STR +2, VIT +2, WIS +1, END +4, Perception +1
Growth affinity: END, VIT
Evolution path: Deep-Forged → Mountain Heart → Living Stone
Class affinity: Warrior, Priest

The System marks you as: IMMOVABLE OBJECT.

options.label: Aye. Made of stone and time.
Not quite. Let me look again.

species_void_confirm.text:
VOID-TOUCHED.

The System attempts to complete its standard analysis and fails. It tries again. It generates an error code it has never generated before and quietly archives it.

Base bonuses: INT +2, AGI +1, LCK +4, WIS +2, Perception +4
Growth affinity: LCK, INT
Evolution path: Void Walker → Reality Bender → System Anomaly
Class affinity: Mage, Rogue

The System marks you as: CLASSIFICATION PENDING.

options.label: Yes. The System doesn't know what to make of me. I'm comfortable with that.

background.text:
ORIGIN PROTOCOL.

The System reads the grooves your past has worn into you — the skills learned from necessity, the habits built for survival, the marks left by a life lived before all this.

Who were you before the Rite?

options.label: Orphan of the Fracture — Lost everything. Built from scratch. Lucky to be alive.
Former Guild Member — Trained, connected, and then something went wrong.
Scholar's Apprentice — The System holds answers. You were taught to ask the right questions.
Street Thief — You took what you needed. You're still not sure if you feel bad about it.
Former Soldier — The orders stopped making sense. You stopped following them.
Farmer's Child — The land gives you everything. The Fracture took the land.
Merchant's Ward — Raised on numbers and negotiation. The System is just another market.
Noble's Bastard — Close enough to power to understand it. Too illegitimate to inherit it.

bg_orphan_confirm.text:
Orphan of the Fracture.

LCK +2, VIT +1
Starting alignment: +5 (cautious optimism — you survived once)

The System notes: high adaptability index. Absence of attachments logged.

bg_guild_confirm.text:
Former Guild Member.

STR +1, WIS +1, END +1, Gold +30, Leather Armor
Starting alignment: 0 (complicated loyalties)

The System notes: guild affiliation history flagged. Reason for departure unrecorded.

bg_scholar_confirm.text:
Scholar's Apprentice.

INT +3, WIS +2, Mana Potion
Starting alignment: +10 (knowledge tends toward order)

The System notes: elevated lore comprehension index. Residual academic trauma detected.

bg_thief_confirm.text:
Street Thief.

INT +1, AGI +3, LCK +1, Gold +15
Starting alignment: -15 (the System judges the method, not the hunger)

The System notes: elevated stealth capability index. Light fingers flagged.

bg_soldier_confirm.text:
Former Soldier.

STR +2, VIT +2, END +2, Iron Sword
Starting alignment: 0 (the war was complicated)

The System notes: combat conditioning registered. Chain of command status: severed.

bg_farmer_confirm.text:
Farmer's Child.

STR +1, LCK +1, VIT +3, END +2, Health Potion
Starting alignment: +15 (proximity to honest work)

The System notes: resilience index: exceptional. Weather-sense module activated.

bg_merchant_confirm.text:
Merchant's Ward.

INT +2, LCK +2, WIS +1, Gold +75
Starting alignment: +5 (enlightened self-interest)

The System notes: trade knowledge registered. Haggling instinct flagged as asset.

bg_noble_confirm.text:
Noble's Bastard.

INT +2, AGI +1, LCK +1, WIS +2, Gold +25
Starting alignment: 0 (you've seen both sides; you're not sure either is right)

The System notes: noble contact network registered. Legitimacy: contested.

affinity.text:
POTENTIAL CLASSIFICATION.

The System has read your species, your history, and the shape of your survival instincts.

Now it needs to know: when the moment comes — when something is in front of you and you have to choose — what do you reach for?

options.label: I've always led with my fists. Strength is the only language that matters.
I've spent years studying. Knowledge is the foundation of all power.
I've survived by being unseen. The hidden path is the only safe one.
I believe in something greater than myself. Service is my purpose.
I adapt. I watch. I find my way in any terrain, any situation.
I don't fit into any of those boxes. I am something else entirely.

confirm_warrior.text:
The light flares red-gold. It recognises the calluses on your knuckles, the set of your jaw, the way you instinctively scan a room for threats.

CLASS AFFINITY: WARRIOR

The System accepts your self-assessment.

confirm_mage.text:
The light deepens to a cool violet. It senses the pathways your mind has carved — the hunger for patterns, the love of understanding, the instinct to reach beyond what can be touched.

CLASS AFFINITY: MAGE

The System accepts your self-assessment.

confirm_rogue.text:
The light dims — deliberately, testing. It finds the habit of watching exits, the practiced stillness, the way you move without thinking to occupy shadows.

CLASS AFFINITY: ROGUE

The System accepts your self-assessment.

confirm_priest.text:
The light becomes warm gold. It senses the places in your chest that have been broken and healed — the scars that became a map of everything you protect.

CLASS AFFINITY: PRIEST

The System accepts your self-assessment.

confirm_ranger.text:
The light spreads outward, reaching like roots. It finds the part of you that belongs more to open spaces — to movement, to watching, to understanding terrain as a language.

CLASS AFFINITY: RANGER

The System accepts your self-assessment.

refuse_definition.text:
The light pauses.

It has seen this before — very rarely, in its long history. Someone who slips through the classification matrix.

The System considers. The pressure against your sternum becomes almost painful.

Then the light goes very, very still.

options.label: Hold your ground. You are what you are.
Perhaps you were being dramatic. Choose a path.
